samples.ref: A sample of 377 women was surveyed, leading to the findings that women in Shiroro are highly entrepreneurial with high level of financial independence, engaging mostly in SMEs.
samples.hyp:
Abakyala abalina emikisa egy’enjawulo ne basaanidde okukola mu biwato eby’enjawulo, nga bwe kiri mu by’enjawulo by’okulimu, okusomesa, n’ensimbi. Okunoonyereza kwagasaako nti abakyala abato nga 18-24 omuli balina obukwanaguzi obungi mu by’okulimu, nga balina ekifo ekikulu mu kusawoza eby’enjawulo.

English:
A sample of 377 women was studied, and the results showed that women in Shiroro are primarily engaged in business, with a strong focus on agriculture, and are more likely to participate in small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). Women with different levels of education work in various sectors, including agriculture, education, and finance. The study also found that young women aged 18-24 have a higher level of engagement in agriculture, playing a significant role in various activities.

Rifampicin, a powerful antibiotic used to treat lung infections, is also administered intravenously to combat bacterial infections that cause tuberculosis meningitis. This drug is on the World Health Organization (WHO) list of essential medicines and is used in countries with a high prevalence of antibiotic resistance.
